sources.title: Challenger Topplesticks Guide - Best Fiddlesticks Top World

passive.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
passive.text: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.

spells.name: Terrify
spells.text: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

spells.name: Bountiful Harvest
spells.text: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.

spells.name: Reap
spells.text: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.

spells.name: Crowstorm
spells.text: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.

damage.value: Fiddlesticks deals sustained area damage with Crowstorm and bonus execute damage at the end of Bountiful Harvest.

axis.value: Fiddlesticks favors close-combat trades and can force a freeze even when contested.

spikes.at: Crowstorm's cooldown falls from 140 to 80 as it ranks up
spikes.why: Fiddlesticks can use its area damage more often.
